description: This repository runs two bots, deliberately, and they do not overlap.
Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) covers the package ecosystems it
understands: github-actions, uv, npm, devcontainers. Renovate is enabled
for `custom.regex` and nothing else, because the gap Dependabot cannot
close is a version literal embedded in a shell script or a workflow step —
it has no equivalent of a custom manager. Those two literals are `uv` and
Widening enabledManagers here would produce duplicate proposals for every
ecosystem Dependabot already covers. See docs/04-build-plan.md § G.

packageRules.description: gitleaks ships a checksum this PR cannot update
prBodyNotes: **This PR does not update the release checksums.** `gitleaks` is verified by `sha256sum -c` at both install sites, and the register records the digest alongside the version. Update all four before merging: `tools.gitleaks.sha256` in `controls.yaml`, the two architecture digests in `.devcontainer/setup.sh`, and the digest in `.github/workflows/standard-check.yml`. Leaving them stale fails the install step rather than passing silently, which is the intended direction — but it fails the build, so do it in this PR.
